title: An order with no line items contributes nothing
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> {
  orderId: order.order_id,
  customer: order.customer,
  sku: li.sku,
  qty: li.qty,
  price: li.price
}))

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> {
  orderId: order.order_id,
  customer: order.customer,
  sku: li.sku,
  qty: li.qty,
  price: li.price
}))

explanation.approach: Mapping over an empty `line_items` array returns an empty array of rows, and `flatMap` concatenating an empty array in is the same as not visiting that order at all — O1 never appears.
